messages:
sara: Heads up — support ticket #45812 reporting missing identity fields (actor.email / actor.ip) on audit exports to our SIEM for tenant t-387.
nate: Seeing similar alerts in our monitoring — sample shows events with user_id but no email or ip after the forwarding step.
luca: Can you paste a raw sample event? is this during gzip/HEC push or earlier in the pipeline?
sara: Pasting redacted sample:
```
{ "event_time": "2026-03-10T20:14:12Z", "event_type": "policy.update", "actor": { "id": "u-9012" }, "tenant": "t-387", "request_id": "req-abc123" }
```
amanda: That looks like actor.email got stripped by the pii-redaction lambda. But we only apply redaction for tenants with pii_masking_enabled. Is t-387 on that flag?
nate: t-387 has pii_masking enabled in the tenant-config db (confirmed). Their customers asked for email masking for compliance reasons.
sara: Ok, but the issue is these fields are missing only on the SIEM forwarder. The hosted Audit API and S3 archives still contain actor.email.
luca: Interesting — that indicates the redaction happened AFTER the S3/export generation but BEFORE SIEM forwarder. Timeline: audit ingestion -> enrichment -> s3 sink -> forwarder. Which component reads from which topic?
security-oncall: ops-bot pushed an alert: "forwarder: tenant t-387 field-suppression detected count=124 in last 15m" :warning:
ops-bot: playbook link: https://internal/playbooks/siem-forwarder-field-suppression
amanda: Quick hypothesis: forwarder has an opt-in filter that strips PII again for tenants with sys_scope=external_forwarding. There's a migration patch that introduced a double-redaction bug (PR #4128).
nate: Repro steps I ran locally:
1) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/query?tenant=t-387\
2) compare S3 object: s3://audit-archive/t-387/2026-03-10/req-abc123.json
3) tail forwarder logs: kubectl logs deployment/siem-forwarder -n prod | grep req-abc123
Log excerpt:
```
[INFO] processing req-abc123 tenant=t-387
[DEBUG] apply_masking: tenant_pii_mask=true
[INFO] publish_hec compressed_size=1724 content_length=1560
```
luca: The publish_hec DEBUG shows apply_masking true — why is forwarder re-applying masks? It should be a no-op if fields already redacted but code path overwrites actor.email.
sara: I found the forwarder config for t-387: forwarding.profile=external-minimal, and forwarding.profile has `strip_sensitive = true`.
amanda: That variable was supposed to toggle removal of full request bodies, not actor.* fields. We probably mapped the wrong config key in the migration. Tracking to PR 4128 — the default for strip_sensitive got expanded to include actor*.
security-oncall: Impact assessment — SIEM customers for t-387 see missing identity fields. This affects incident triage and retention queries. Need rollback on forwarder mapping or a backfill.
nate: Short-term mitigation: set forwarding.profile for t-387 to external-full (disable strip_sensitive) — ops change. I can push a tenant override via admin UI.
luca: Medium-term: fix PR mapping so strip_sensitive doesn't touch actor.email/ip, add unit tests, and deploy to canary.
sara: Backfill plan — we can replay S3 objects through the forwarder with a replay flag that disables redaction on replay. Steps:
- create replay job for prefix s3://audit-archive/t-387/2026-03-10/
- run replay service with env REPLAY_DISABLE_STRIP=true
- verify sample event shows actor.email in Splunk HEC (check _raw)
amanda: Also need to check HEC content-length vs gzip size — if replays fail we'll see 400s. I ran a quick check and saw occasional 412 precondition fails in forwarder logs earlier this week.
ops-bot: queued task: create-backfill-job t-387 2026-03-10 -> job-5621
security-oncall: Action items:
- nate: apply tenant override to stop stripping (ETA 15m)
- luca: open PR to revert mapping and add tests (ETA 1d)
- sara: verify backfill job results and notify customer (ETA after backfill)
- amanda: correlate forwarder 4xx errors and report replay failures (ETA 4h)

nate: Tenant override applied. Monitoring shows forwarder now sending events with actor.email again. Will monitor for 30m and then start the replay.
sara: Starting replay job job-5621 now. I'll paste results when complete.

(30m later)
sara: Replay finished: 3,210 events replayed, Splunk shows actor.email present in samples, no 4xx in the replay run. Noted a handful of HEC timeouts — retry logic handled them.
security-oncall: Customer notified and escalated ticket updated with root cause + remediation. Closing the urgent outage queue item. :white_check_mark:

luca: Filed PR #4189 to fix the mapping and added an integration test that runs a small sample through forwarder ensuring actor.email survives if already present.
amanda: I'll add a short KB entry explaining tenant forwarding profiles and the masking implications so support can triage quicker.

sara: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: deploy PR tomorrow to canary, schedule a retro to avoid config semantics drift.
